September 21, 1971
2014-12-12T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/september-21-1971-54694

Mukti Bahini prevents a Pak attack in Balla village under Harirampur thana. Two Pak soldiers are killed. The Paki raiders brutally kill 16 unarmed villagers to take revenge.

The Pak Election Commission reschedules the by-election date. It is now from December 12 to December 23.
